title: The Mislabelled Drawers
introduction: The Vance Municipal Archive was reorganised in 1974 by somebody who has since left no forwarding address, and four archivists are still trying to work out who put what where. There are 4 archivists. Each files on a different one of four shelves, listed from lower to higher: the bottom shelf, the second shelf, the third shelf, the fourth shelf. The archivists are Dr Mwangi, Mr Pelletier, Ms Castellano and Mr Ravensworth, and each covers a different one of these decades: the 1890s, the 1950s, the 1830s and the 1910s. Within each category every member belongs to a different archivist, so each shelf, name and decade is used exactly once.
clues: The archivist who covers the 1950s files on the third shelf, and Mr Pelletier files on the second shelf.
The archivist who files on the fourth shelf files exactly one shelf higher than Ms Castellano.
The archivist who covers the 1890s and the archivist who files on the second shelf are exactly one shelf apart.
Mr Ravensworth and the archivist who covers the 1950s are exactly one shelf apart.
Mr Pelletier files on a lower shelf than the archivist who covers the 1830s.
